headline: Stock of the Day: Is Walmart Setting up to Rally Ahead of its Earnings?
summary: Walmart (WMT) is quiet ahead of earnings. Resistance is at $117, but a breakout is possible. Old saying 'buy on rumor, sell on news' applies.

headline: Walmart Q2 Preview: Retailer Beats Revenue 25 Straight Quarters, Could Streak Extension Help Close Gap with Target Stock?
summary: Walmart has a streak of consistently beating analyst estimates for revenue. The streak hasn't translated into stock gains. Could things change?

headline: Walmart Could Swing $41.4 Billion In Value After Earnings
summary: Earnings back in focus on Thursday: Benzinga-selected slate runs from big-box retail and off-price apparel to industrial machinery & niche tech. Walmart is the marquee name, with 4.50% implied move. Deere & Ross Stores also reporting with 5.64% and 6.94% implied moves respectively.
